scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite-dimensional canonical diagonal pinching in weak Schatten quasi-norms, not general Schur masks, block pinching, or strong Schatten norms.

Known Schur-Horn majorization and classical singular-value inequalities provide the spectral ingredient; the new calculation is its sharp rank-constrained quantitative optimization and extremizer support classification.
An older equivalent Hardy-Lorentz projection-norm identity has not been ruled out completely; independent audit is not performed.
title: Rank-constrained weak-Schatten diagonal pinching: an exact three-phase law
